(ix) इलेक्ट्रॉन के स्थानान्तरण से बने यौगिक कहलाते हैं
    (a) सहसंयोजी   (b) वैद्युत संयोजी   (c) कार्बनिक   (d) इनमें से कोई नहीं।

(xii) आवर्त सारणी के प्रथम वर्ग के सदस्य है

raw.en:
(viii) What type of reaction is CuO + H2 -> Cu + H2O ?
    (a) Oxidation   (b) Reduction   (c) Neutralisation   (d) Redox.

(ix) The compound formed by transfer of electrons is called
    (a) covalent   (b) electrovalent   (c) carbonic   (d) none of these.

(x) Brass is an example of
    (a) metal   (b) non-metal   (c) alloy   (d) metalloid.

(xi) Carbon combining with hydrogen forms
    (a) ionic compound   (b) hydrocarbon   (c) halogen   (d) aqua regia.

(xii) The members of 1st group of the periodic table are
    (a) acid metal   (b) alkaline metal   (c) inert gas   (d) alloy.

(xiii) The presence of CO2 gas in atmosphere is
    (a) 0.01%   (b) 0.05%   (c) 0.03%   (d) 0.02%

notes: Left half = printed page 13 (viii-x), right half = printed page 14 (xi-xiii).
Handwritten mark on (ix) points to 'covalent' — this is WRONG, transfer of electrons gives an electrovalent (ionic) compound. Not an answer source (F3).
